verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਲਖ ਚਾਨਣੇ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dh sooraj lakh chaanane til na pujan satigur matee|

en.bdb: The light of lacs of moons and suns cannot become equal to an iota of the wisdom of the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਕਾਸ ਲਖ ਉਚੀ ਨੀਵੀ ਕਿਰਣ ਨ ਰਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh paataal akaas lakh uchee neevee kiran na ratee|

en.bdb: Millions of nether worlds and millions of skies exist but there is not the slightest maladjustment in their alignment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਲਖ ਪਉਣ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗਨ ਵਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh paanee lakh paun mil ra(n)g bira(n)g tara(n)gan vatee|

en.bdb: Lacs of airs and waters join to create moving waves of different hues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਮਧ ਪਲੁ ਲਖ ਪਰਲਉ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਉਤਪਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: aadh na a(n)t na madh pal lakh paralau lakh lakh utapatee|

en.bdb: Millions of creations and millions of dissolutions continuously alternate without the beginning, middle and end of the process.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪਰਬਤ ਲਖ ਧਰਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: dheeraj dharam na pujanee lakh lakh parabat lakh dharatee|

en.bdb: Lacs of forbearing earths and mountains cannot equate the teachings of the true Guru in perseverance and righteousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਤਿਲ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh giaan dhiaan lakh tul na tuleeaai til gurmatee|

en.bdb: Millions types of knowledges and meditations are not equal to even a particle of the knowledge of the wisdom of Guru (gunnat).
I have sacrified Lacs of rays of lights for one ray of the meditation upon the Lord.
